description: In production the server sends the minified core and components runtimes, so development warnings, such as the dirty form warning that prints typed values, never run

browserSteps.value: The core runtime served at the one core URL is the minified build

fetch(document.querySelector('link[rel=modulepreload][href$="/ppframework.core.es.js"]').href).then(response => response.text()).then(source => { if (source.includes('is now dirty')) { throw new Error('the served core runtime holds development warnings'); } return true; })
Record when the runtime marks the form dirty, through the same runtime instance
import('/_piko/dist/ppframework.core.es.js').then(runtime => { window.__formDirty = false; runtime.piko.hooks.on('form:dirty', () => { window.__formDirty = true; }); return true; })

new Promise((resolve, reject) => { const deadline = performance.now() + 5000; const poll = () => { if (window.__formDirty === true) { resolve(true); return; } if (performance.now() > deadline) { reject(new Error('the form was never marked dirty')); return; } setTimeout(poll, 20); }; poll(); })
The components runtime served at its one URL is the minified build, so its warnings never run

fetch('/_piko/dist/ppframework.components.es.js').then(response => response.text()).then(reexport => { const target = /from "([^"]+)"/.exec(reexport); if (!target) { throw new Error('the components URL is not a re-export: ' + reexport); } return fetch(new URL(target[1], new URL('/_piko/dist/', location.href))); }).then(response => response.text()).then(source => { if (source.includes('resolved to an empty tag name')) { throw new Error('the served components runtime holds development warnings'); } return true; })

browserSteps.message: resolved to an empty tag name
